context: Data visualization — letter-value plot comparing five distribution shapes (symmetric, right-skewed, left-skewed, bimodal, heavy-tailed) with a chart/table toggle
first_impression: A cohesive, intentionally designed visualization where the sequential blue depth ramp elegantly encodes quantile nesting and all five distribution shapes read immediately from their box geometries.
what_works: The sequential blue palette mapping darker shades to inner quantiles and lighter to outer is a deliberate, effective encoding choice — not a default. Data-ink ratio is excellent: ghost dashed gridlines (#e8e8e8), y-axis domain removed, muted outlier dots, legend compact.
what_doesnt: The title at 18px feels slightly undersized relative to the chart canvas (1200px wide), weakening typographic authority. The chart/table toggle buttons could better visually signal the active state beyond background fill — active state blends with the blue swatch in the legend nearby.
